consent.text:
The owner of {name} ({host}) registered this address for your account and would like to send you account email, such as a password reset.

To allow it and confirm your address, open this link:
{url}

Nothing is sent until you confirm. If you do not know {name}, ignore this email: nothing changes. This request expires in 7 days.
page.title: Allow {name} to email you?
page.intro: {name}, the KROMA server at {host}, would like to send account email to {address}. Only that server can use this permission, and only for this address.
page.deny: If you do not know this server, close this page. Nothing will be sent.
page.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
page.invalidDesc: It expired or was already used. Ask the server's owner to send a new one.
